name: smp.js
description: Compile annotated JavaScript to threaded, SIMD WebAssembly. OpenMP-style directives; the annotated source still runs as plain JS.
author: Fazli Sapuan <fazli@sapuan.org>

scripts.bench:lapack: node bin/smp.js build examples/hseqr.js --out examples/build --memory 600 && node examples/bench-hseqr.js --lapack
scripts.bench:single: node bin/smp.js build examples/hseqr.js --out examples/build --memory 600 && node examples/bench-single.js
scripts.bench:geodesic: node bin/smp.js build examples/geodesic.js --out examples/build --memory 800 && node examples/bench-geodesic.js
